Driven by 8 cores and 16 threads operating at a 3.4 GHz base clock and up to a 4.5 GHz max boost clock, this 7nm Zen 3 processor features revolutionary AMD 3D V-Cache technology. By vertically stacking a massive 96 MB of L3 cache directly onto the processor die, reducing latency to ensure your 1 percent low frame rates remain beautifully smooth and perfectly stabilised during intense, data-heavy gameplay. For superior thermal management, the CPU is premium bundled with a next generation Carbice Ice Pad, a long lasting solid thermal interface material that simplifies installation by entirely replacing traditional thermal paste. This seamless drop-in solution for AMD 400 and 500 series motherboards, provides a highly durable, future-proof asset for gamers looking to extract absolute peak value out of their existing hardware configuration.
